title: monitor.alert.opened.v1
description: yc-monitor raised an alert. Published under the alert's tenant (_platform for platform alerts). yc-message emails the admins named in notify.

rule.description: The alert rule's name, e.g. dlq_rate or service_unhealthy.

summary.description: One line for people, e.g. 'yc-pricing failed 3 health checks'.

dimensions.description: What the alert is about, e.g. {"service": "yc-pricing"}.

value.description: The measured value that crossed the threshold, for threshold rules.

notify.description: Who should be told: the platform's system admins, the tenant's shop admins, or nobody (empty).
